001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
010import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
011
012/**
013 * Adds a <a href="https://logback.qos.ch/manual/encoders.html#JsonEncoder">Logback style
014 * JSON encoder</a> to encoder registry with {@value LogbackJsonEncoder#LOGBACK_SCHEME}
015 * URI scheme.
016 */
017@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
018public class LogbackJsonEncoderConfigurator implements Configurator {
019
020        /**
021         * Default constructor for service loader.
022         */
023        public LogbackJsonEncoderConfigurator() {
024        }
025
026        @Override
027        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
028                config.encoderRegistry().register(LogbackJsonEncoder.LOGBACK_SCHEME, new LogbackJsonEncoderProvider());
029                return true;
030        }
031
032        private static class LogbackJsonEncoderProvider implements EncoderProvider {
033
034                @Override
035                public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
036                        return (name, c) -> {
037                                LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder b = new LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder(name);
038                                b.fromProperties(c.properties(), ref);
039                                return b.build();
040                        };
041                }
042
043        }
044
045}
